name: CoP - Provider A Completes, Deleted, Provider B Completes, Provider A Reinstated
description: Provider A creates a short course, gets approved, and completes it (30% + completion in one PUT). Provider A's record is then removed via DELETE. Provider B creates a new short course for the same learner, gets approved, and also completes it. Finally, Provider A's deleted record is reinstated by re-submitting the ILR data including the original completion date — creating a scenario where both providers have conflicting completion claims.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates a Short Course
Employer Approves Provider A Short Course
SLD (Provider A) Claims 30% Milestone and Completion
SLD Removes Provider A Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Short Course
Employer Approves Provider B Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Claims 30% Milestone and Completion
SLD Reinstates Provider A Short Course
